title: Gangtise MCP 对接配置
description: 填写岗底斯开放平台 Access Key / Secret Key。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy，连接时注入请求头 accessKey / secretKey，不出本机。表单字段使用 gangtiseAccessKey / gangtiseSecretKey，避免与客户端内部或环境变量名冲突。
description_en: Enter your Gangtise open-platform Access Key / Secret Key. Credentials are stored only on this device under ~/.workbuddy and injected into request headers (accessKey / secretKey) when connecting. Form field keys are gangtiseAccessKey / gangtiseSecretKey to avoid clashing with client internals or env var names.
docLabel: 如何获取开放平台 AK/SK？

fields.label: Access Key
fields.placeholder: 开放平台 → 我的账号 → 账号列表
fields.placeholder_en: Open Platform → My Account → Account List

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.placeholder: 与 Access Key 成对的 Secret Key
fields.placeholder_en: Secret Key paired with the Access Key
fields.description: 开放平台 Secret Key（SK），请妥善保管。
fields.description_en: Open-platform Secret Key (SK). Keep it secret.
